decisions.reason: The USB enumeration requirement does not change any established GPIO assignment or candidate GPIO pool.
The source concerns native USB behavior on integrated boards and does not change the three-board interboard connector or its D+/D- pinout.
USB enumeration modes do not affect the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cabling constraints.
The source reports that power operates correctly but does not change the interboard power topology, connectors, or pin rules.
Testing integrated-board samples and requiring USB enumeration do not change the defined board variants or their architectural roles.
The native USB enumeration requirement does not affect the addressable LED power, data drive, or level-shifting design.
The source does not change any e-paper backlight supply, switching, PWM, or component requirement.
The statement that the boards power up correctly is runtime status and does not modify the AXP2101 power-management requirements.
USB enumeration behavior does not change the PIR sensor input interface or its electrical biasing.
Normal and forced USB enumeration modes do not entail a change to the panel button or switch interfaces.
The source does not alter the panel reset connector, location, or EN-to-GND action.
The native USB enumeration requirement has no necessary effect on the capacitive-touch inputs or their bias configuration.
